Game Overview

At its heart, Idle Island: Build And Survive is a building game about survive on a deserted island by strategically harnessing resources, crafting tools, and constructing your haven. Your keen planning and decisive actions turn challenges into opportunities, transforming a barren landscape into a bustling haven. Enjoy the thrill of survival as you evolve and master your environment in an exciting, engaging blend of genres.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Idle Island: Build And Survive is easy to pick up. Survive on a deserted island by strategically harnessing resources, crafting tools, and constructing your haven.
